description: This file defines an abstract class 'ArrayElement' in the Drupal core configuration schema, implementing interfaces for iterable and complex data handling, with methods for managing configuration elements, translatability, and data definitions.

classes.name: ArrayElement
classes.description: An abstract class representing a configuration element containing multiple properties, supporting iteration, translatability checks, and nested data management.

methods.name: hasTranslatableElements
methods.description: Checks recursively if any contained element is translatable.

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Returns all valid configuration data keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Builds an array of contained TypedDataInterface elements based on current value and definitions.

methods.name: getElementDefinition
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve data definition for a given key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested configuration property by dot notation.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns the array of element objects, parsing if necessary.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the configuration value is empty.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the configuration value to an array.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over contained elements.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a typed data element from definition, value, and key.

methods.name: buildDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates a data definition object from an array and configuration.

methods.name: isNullable
methods.description: Checks if the element allows NULL values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value within the configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns all properties as an array.
